titles.romaji: Juusenki L-Gaim II: Farewell My Lovely + Pentagona Doors
titles.native: 重戦機エルガイムII フェアウェル マイ ラブリー+ペンタゴナ ドールズ

description: A recap OVA that portrays the second half of the series Heavy Metal L-Gaim. After the credits, there is a short clip animated for the OVA entitled "Pentagona Doors", which is intended to be comic relief.
